evidence.reason: At the current tip, `+++`/`---` header values are used raw and only an unquoted `a/` or `b/` prefix is stripped. A Git-quoted header such as `+++ "b/src/a\tb.ts"` leaves the path as `"b/src/a\tb.ts"`, so path-scoped denylist rules like `^src/` do not match and added content can be missed. This is a concrete fail-open in the intended denylist scan, not a new requirement.
